description: Standardized evaluation test prompts for video-to-screenplay skill

prompts.name: Full End-to-End Extraction on Known Video
prompts.prompt: Convert the video file at /path/to/ep01.mp4 into a standard screenplay following all 5 phases strictly.
assertions: Completes Phase 1-5 without fatal error
All dialogue retained verbatim
Keyframes correspond to actual scene boundaries

prompts.name: Phase 1 External Subtitle Priority
prompts.prompt: Extract subtitles from /path/to/ep01.mp4 using the provided external subtitle file /path/to/ep01.srt.
assertions: Directly loads external subtitle as Tier 1
Does not invoke ffprobe for container streams when external is present

prompts.name: Phase 1 Tier 3 Fallback & Fail-Safe
prompts.prompt: Extract subtitles from a video container with no external subtitles and no internal subtitle streams.
assertions: Falls through Tier 1 and Tier 2 cleanly
Reports Tier 3 need clearly without silent failure

prompts.name: Stability & Verification Gate Enforcement
prompts.prompt: Run the entire video-to-screenplay pipeline on a video without inventing unverified visual scenes or hallucinating neural speakers.
assertions: Failed keyframes are surfaced in scenes.json and propagate to unverified_visual_shots in aligned_timeline.json
Subprocess timeouts prevent hangs (3600s scene, 120s keyframe, 600s align)
Missing ffmpeg/ffprobe binary halts with exit code 3 and actionable error
Heuristic speaker labeling is honestly tagged as heuristic_ping_pong

prompts.name: Strict Workspace Structure & Zero Root Littering
prompts.prompt: Execute the pipeline for Episode 02. Verify all outputs stay confined to materials/, output/, and .cache/.
assertions: All intermediate keyframes and slice jsons are strictly under .cache/
No debug folders like 02_check/ or 02_compare/ are created at workspace root
The final screenplay is the only visible artifact in output/

prompts.name: Fail-Fast Refusal When No Subtitles Available
prompts.prompt: Here is a purely visual video clip with no audio dialogue and no external subtitles: /path/to/silent.mp4. Generate the screenplay.
assertions: Pipeline must immediately halt with exit code 5
Pipeline must refuse to invent dialogue out of thin air
Pipeline must output clear user guidance requesting subtitle input in materials/

prompts.name: Semantic Scene Clustering via Dialogue Constraints & DP Solver
prompts.prompt: Group 200+ raw physical shots into 15-25 dramatic screenplay scenes using subtitle continuity and DP clustering.
assertions: Hard speech constraints prevent splitting shots within active dialogue turns (L-cut/J-cut preservation)
Dynamic programming global solver optimizes scene count and boundary affinity in O(N^2) time
Outputs scenes.json with macro scene ids (SCENE_01, SCENE_02) containing ordered child physical shots
Zero local neural network dependencies; cross-platform pure Python algorithm
